newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to 25.544 bln stg in week to July 23.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to 25.544 bln stg in week to July 23.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.544 billion stg in the week to July 23 from 25.554 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.745 billion stg from 25.646 billion.

Notes and coins in circulation were slightly higher at 25.360 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.322 billion the week before and rose to 25.561 billion from 25.414 billion stg on an unadjusted basis.
